dateEventUtc.description: The date and time the ship arrives at a specified location, ATA.
The date and time the ship departs from a specified location, ATD.
The date and time when the reporting event occurred.

distanceToGo.description: The remaining distance in nautical miles reported by the vessel to a specific destination.
The remaining sailing distance until next port (over ground), measured in nautical miles.

draftAft.description: Maximum ship present static draught in meters and centimeters.
The vertical distance in metres between the waterline and the bottom of the hull, with the thickness of the hull included from aft.

draftFore.description: Maximum ship present static draught in meters and centimeters.
The vertical distance in metres between the waterline and the bottom of the hull, with the thickness of the hull included from forward.

draftMid.description: Maximum ship present static draught in meters and centimeters.

etb.description: The date and time the ship estimates to reach the specified location in port.

etd.description: The date and time the ship is estimated to depart from a specified location, ETD.

eventKey.description: A code representing the event which triggers the reporting (e.g. Noon Report, Arrival, Departure). Event may vary according to contract.
A code representing the type of operation being undertaken for the duration of the report (e.g. sailing, in port loading, at anchor).

freshWaterConsumed.description: Fresh drinking water consumed onboard, measured in metric tons.

freshWaterProduced.description: Fresh water produced onboard by running the Fresh Water Generator, measured in metric tons.

freshWaterSupplied.description: Fresh water bunkered onboard, measured in metric tons.

hourSlr.description: The duration in hours since previous event report.

isEuPort.description: Reporting jurisdiction covering the arriving port for ship voyage. This is used to define the mandatory reporting requirements  related to ship emissions  for different voyages.
Reporting jurisdiction covering the departure port for the ship voyage. This is used to define the mandatory reporting requirements related to ship emissions for different voyages.

legNo.description: The identifier used to uniquely describe a leg of a voyage. The identifier can be a reference to features in another electronic dataset such as a route plan.

nextPortCode.description: The port immediately subsequent to the port of departure.

nextPortEtaLtc.description: The date and time the ship plans to reach the specified location in port.

nextPortEtaUtc.description: The date and time the ship is estimated to arrive at a specified location, ETA.

nextPortName.description: The name and country of the port immediately subsequent to the port of departure.

portCode.description: A code in the message to show whether the information is submitted for the ship arrival or departure.
The name and country of the port immediately previous to the port of arrival.
A code representing the port where the ship arrives.
The code representing the port from which the ship departs.
The name and country of a previous port of call.
A code representing the port where the fuel is to be bunkered, according to a bunker delivery note.

portName.description: A code representing the port immediately previous to the port of arrival.
The name and country of the port where the ship arrives.
A name and country of the port from which the ship departs.
A code representing a previous port of call.
The name and country of the port where the fuel is to be bunkered, according to a bunker delivery note.

positionLat.description: A name, number or description used to identify a berth position. A berth position is a specific position within a berth where a vessel may be moored or anchored. (IHO Concept register).
The latitude (geographical coordinate) of an entity.
The latitude (geographical coordinate) of the location of the ship at the time of reporting.

positionLon.description: A name, number or description used to identify a berth position. A berth position is a specific position within a berth where a vessel may be moored or anchored. (IHO Concept register).
The longitude (geographical coordinate) of an entity.
The longitude (geographical coordinate) of the location of the ship at the time of reporting.

relWindDirection.description: Best estimate of the direction of wind relative to the ship, measured in degrees, made by the seafarer onboard.

robDo.description: Remaining fuel onboard based on Engine Room log entries, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

robFreshWater.description: Fresh drinking water remaining onboard, measured in metric tons.

robGecylOil.description: The cylinder lube oil remaining onboard based on Engine Room log entries, measured in metric tons.

robHfo.description: Remaining fuel onboard based on Engine Room log entries, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

robLsfo.description: Remaining fuel onboard based on Engine Room log entries, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

robMecylOil.description: The cylinder lube oil remaining onboard based on Engine Room log entries, measured in metric tons.

robMelscylOil.description: The cylinder lube oil remaining onboard based on Engine Room log entries, measured in metric tons.

robMgo.description: Remaining fuel onboard based on Engine Room log entries, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

robUlsfo.description: Remaining fuel onboard based on Engine Room log entries, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

robUlsmgo.description: Remaining fuel onboard based on Engine Room log entries, measured in metric tons since last reporting.

shipCourse.description: The ship current course over ground indicated in the 360 degrees notation from true north.
The direction in which the ship is pointing with respect to true north, expressed in degrees.

steamingDistanceSlr.description: The distance traveled within the time elapsed, over ground measured in nautical miles.

trueWindDirection.description: A code indicating the true direction, in tens of degrees, from which wind is blowing (of will blow).
Best estimate of the direction of wind, measured in degrees true, made by the seafarer onboard.

voyNo.description: An operator-assigned reference code for the ship's voyage.

waveDirection.description: Best estimate of the direction of sea, in degrees true, made by the seafarer onboard.

waveHeight.description: Recorded sea height in metres as per weather provider.

callsign.description: The ship's identification used primarily for radio communications.

flag.description: A code representing the nationality of the ship shown on its IMO ship's certificate.

grossTonnage.description: The gross tonnage shown on the ship's International Tonnage Certificate or other document issued by the flag State or recognized organization.

imoNo.description: The ship identification number shown on its IMO ship's certificate.

shipName.description: The ship's name shown on the IMO ship's certificates.

netTonnage.description: The net tonnage shown on the ship's International Tonnage Certificate or other document issued by the Flag State or Recognized Organization.

portOfRegistry.description: The name and country for the Port of Registry shown on the IMO ship certificate.

mmsi.description: The unique radio identification number (ship station identity).

masterName.description: The given name of the person in charge of the ship.
